verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents data retention settings or end-user data deletion and suppression. The Privacy Portal is described only as streamlining responses to privacy regulations and detecting and classifying data, and a general claim of GDPR/CCPA compliance tooling does not establish this capability. The Public API's CRUD covers workspace resources such as Sources, Destinations and Warehouses, not customer data deletion, and consent management is an adjacent control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
